evidence_boundary.reason_new_candidate_is_not_C10_repair: The tested belief changes from a 70% aggressive equity risk budget to the user's long-discussed 60/40 strategic risk budget; C10 rules and results remain immutable.

economic_hypothesis.causal_chain: Point-in-time CSI500 valuation and twelve-month relative total-return leadership identify slow-moving mid-cap versus dividend-low-volatility style preference; a bounded monthly tilt within a fixed 60% equity budget captures part of that persistence, while 30% bonds and 10% cash limit joint-loss exposure.
economic_hypothesis.why_repeatable: Valuation mean reversion is slow and style leadership is reinforced by institutional reallocation and investor extrapolation; monthly decisions match that horizon.
economic_hypothesis.expected_tradeoff: Lower CAGR than C10 but lower concentration, drawdown and marked-stress risk.
economic_hypothesis.falsification: Reject if net base CAGR is below 7.5%, base MDD exceeds 30%, extreme MDD exceeds 40%, any marked-stress path exceeds 45%, or the candidate fails its frozen baselines and ablation controls.
